text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
My last race... didn't go well. I wasn't 
able to show anything I worked so hard 
for...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I was frustrated, so very frustrated. 
Even when I was smiling, somewhere deep 
down... I was always thinking about the 
day I lost.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'll win today... and this time, I will 
stand at the center of the stage!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, go bring home the win!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm going to give it every single 
thing I've got!
